critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Self-read guard is placed CORRECTLY: before the ocr.readLines() fallback, after the node path (which already filters to Platforms.packages so our own package would produce no parsed offer anyway). Idempotent: returns silently without resetting lastOfferSignature — safe because when the user is back in a VTC app the next event triggers normal handleScreen flow. Import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityWindowInfo present (line 11). windows API available since API 21 ✓.
✅ isOwnAppInForeground() uses runCatching + getOrDefault(false) — safe if system denies windows access or returns null root.

✅ Diagnostics.shortSummary emits counters and timestamps only. Verified by grep: no occurrence of 'Accepter', '€', 'km', or RideOffer.grossPriceEuros in the shortSummary output path. The on-screen Dashboard call-site uses diagnosticSummary() → Diagnostics.shortSummary ✓. The old summary()/report() with offer texts is only written to the SHARED .txt file (not rendered to a Text composable).

✅ Journal ring buffer: synchronized ArrayDeque addLast + removeFirst while size > 200 — thread-safe. Fed by onDecision (every decision) and onAnalysis (only when a NEW detection line appears, deduped vs lastDetected). report() appends '--- JOURNAL ---' then lines ✓.

✅ FileProvider authority '${context.packageName}.fileprovider' matches AndroidManifest (verified in iter8 report) and <cache-path name="exports" path="exports/"/> in res/xml/file_paths.xml. Share intent uses text/plain + EXTRA_STREAM + FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION — standard pattern.

✅ CsvImporter.parse robust to Excel-edited files: columns found by header NAME (lowercased, Locale.FRANCE), separator auto-detect (';' vs ','), BOM stripped, quoted fields split correctly, decimal comma + NBSP (\u00A0) + regular space tolerated in numbers. Date SimpleDateFormat uses isLenient = false so garbage like 'pas une date' is correctly rejected and counted in skipped. Default status 'Prise'/ACCEPTED when 'Statut' column missing — matches ancien-export compatibility goal ✓.

✅ CsvImporter recomputes grossPricePerKmEuros and grossHourlyRateEuros when cells are empty: `d(iGrossKm) ?: if (totalKm > 0) price / totalKm else null` — zero-division guarded. CsvImporterTest #2 verifies 12.62 / 9.0 within 0.001 ✓.

✅ RideRepository.importRides dedupes against BOTH existing rows AND intra-import duplicates (HashSet.add returns true only for fresh keys). Key granularity 'capturedAtEpochMs/60_000' = minute buckets, so re-importing the same CSV is a no-op (returns 0). Copies rides with id = 0 before insertAll so Room auto-generates fresh PKs ✓.

✅ HistoryScreen Importer launcher: ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument accepts mime array ['text/*', 'application/vnd.ms-excel', 'application/octet-stream'] — covers Google Drive / Files / Downloads providers that misreport .csv mimetype. contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { ... bufferedReader(UTF_8).readText() } — resource-safe via .use, UTF-8 explicit (BOM is handled downstream by removePrefix('\uFEFF')).

✅ Round-trip simulation (/tmp/CsvRoundTrip.kt) proves: 2 rides exported with full status/score/€/km brut/€/h brut/ratio seuil → re-parsed → all numeric fields equal within 0.01, status mapping 'Pas prise'→REJECTED / 'Prise'→ACCEPTED, dates round-trip at minute precision (SimpleDateFormat 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' drops seconds — which is exactly why RideRepository.importRides uses minute buckets for dedupe).
ℹ MINOR (non-blocker): CsvImporter.col() lower-cases both the header and each candidate name on every lookup — tiny perf overhead; irrelevant at CSV scale.

ℹ MINOR: shortSummary includes 'Lignes dans le journal' which is purely a count — safe (digit-only, no false-positive OCR of offer price). The service's `isOwnAppInForeground()` would still cover any accidental leak of offer text to UI.

rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature + bug-fix validation, not a bug RCA. Self-read bug RCA (from main agent context): the Diagnostic card on Dashboard was previously rendering the raw read-back texts (lastNodes.texts, lastOcr.texts) via Diagnostics.summary() in a Text composable. When the service's ScreenOcr fallback captured the screen, it OCR'd our own Dashboard, which contained prices and 'Accepter' strings copied from the last offer card — the parser dutifully detected these as a new offer. Fix: (a) remove offer-text from on-screen diagnostic (shortSummary), (b) hard guard in handleScreen via isOwnAppInForeground() so even if the on-screen text ever regressed, OCR is skipped when VTC Copilot is the active window. Belt-and-suspenders — correct approach.
